name: type-design
author: felipeblassioli
abstract: Design and audit TypeScript types as a modeling discipline — making illegal states unrepresentable and encoding domain truth — rather than as a mechanical lint pass. Applies proportional rigor (no type gymnastics, wire/transport concerns kept out of domain types) and returns either a designed type with its rejected alternatives or principle-grounded audit findings. Bundles references/house-defaults.md (team TS conventions, skippable outside that context) and references/worked-examples.md, plus an evals/ suite.
